simple.meaning: צָרַח (tsârach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be clear (in tone, i.e. shrill ), i.e. to whoop.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man.
The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
